'''Ankori-7''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Ankori system/Legends|Ankori system]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

==History==
Following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the world was chosen by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], the [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], as the secret hiding place of his traitorous sister-in-law, [[Deara Antilles]]. Antilles had been discovered communicating with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and attempting to turn over Organa's adopted daughter [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="LOTJ" />
